text:
Hi all,

For the citizenship application (at the end of the A5 process), do I have to get new documents from my home country (e.g. police report, personal status from home country) even though I have been living in Israel for the past 5+ years, or can I resubmit the ones I have submitted earlier in the A5 process? (We are married)

Also, I saw someone write in here about a personal letter with the reason for wanting citizenship, but I don't see this mentioned in the knowledge base in aic.org.il. Can anyone help me understand what is required here?

And lastly, we are in the TLV branch - anyone has tips on the "contact PIBA to clarify document requirements" part that's mentioned in the article on aic.org.il? Do you just write an email to the ashrot51@piba.gov.il email, and what do you ask?
